programme.title: Farscape, Season: 3, Episode: 16
programme.desc: Injured Crichton escapes into a cartoonish world while D'Argo's actions threaten Moya.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 7, Episode: 6
programme.desc: After Gus is tasked with taking care of his girlfriend's son Maximus for the day, he jeopardizes their relationship when an innocent trip to the circus turns deadly.

programme.title: Hunter, Season: 1, Episode: 8
programme.desc: Jonnie Joe Walker is a bounty hunter who beats the outlaws he brings in for rewards.

programme.title: Renegade, Season: 5, Episode: 20
programme.desc: When Reno arrests a bounty with a bad luck streak, the bad luck transfers to Reno when the two get locked up. While they're in prison, the guards stage death fights between inmates.

programme.title: Renegade, Season: 5, Episode: 21
programme.desc: The bounty hunters are staking out the home of a wanted fugitive. By posing as a neighbor, Reno gets close to the man's family.

programme.title: The Irrational, Season: 1, Episode: 4
programme.desc: Alec and the team take on a kidnapping case at the request of a desperate father. Their investigation is hampered by a complicated family dynamic that slowly reveals everyone’s hidden motivations.

programme.title: The Irrational, Season: 1, Episode: 5
programme.desc: Alec and the team head to Las Vegas to help Camille, a former colleague turned expert poker player who’s been lured into danger. They must take some risks to solve a gambling mystery before Camille gets hurt. Marisa makes a significant discovery.

programme.title: Glass Jaw
programme.desc: A one-time champion boxer cant control his anger and winds up going to prison and loses everything. After his release, he seeks redemption and is determined to reclaim his belt and more importantly his true love.

programme.title: Her Deadly Reflections
programme.desc: Kelly’s life is upended when she wakes up in the hospital with fragments of her memory. Danger follows her, and the only thing she is certain of is that the people closest to her are the very ones she’s not sure she can trust.

programme.title: Hard Times
programme.desc: The village of Kilcoulin's Leap was once a thriving spa town and home to a famous Holy Well, but now offers little by way of employment for its people. When a group of friends come up with a plan to hijack a consignment of Viagra and sell it on the open market, they don’t count on the muscular response of Viagra's makers. In a panic, they hide the load of Viagra down the town's Holy Well.

programme.title: Deadly Vows
programme.desc: Pastry chef Helena poisons men who don’t meet her high standards. Her fiancé Charlie has nothing to worry about — at least until his sister Becca becomes suspicious of Helena’s culinary killing past. It’s up to Becca to save Charlie from both the altar and the grave.

programme.title: Drone Wars
programme.desc: In a flash, the invasion began and ended. Filled with smoke and fire, the sky is now littered with ships hovering above for miles in every direction. These ships reap the Earth of all its resources, while DRONES patrol the now-ruined cities, taking out anything that they deem a threat. Human survivors group together, desperately trying to resurrect any semblance of normalcy they once had. Amidst the chaos, a small team of scientists hidden away in the bowels of Los Angeles are all that is left to defeat the drones and take down the motherships once and for all.

programme.title: Last Knights
programme.desc: Gladiator meets Game of Thrones in this electrifying epic starring Academy Award winner Morgan Freeman and Academy Award nominee Clive Owen.In an age of honour and justice by the sword, Raiden is a fallen warrior who must rise up against a corrupt and sadistic ruler to avenge Bartok, his dishonoured master. This sword-clashing adventure is a stunning cinematic experience not to be missed.

programme.title: Global Meltdown
programme.desc: The Earth is breaking apart, people are killing each other, and fire is raining from the sky - Just another day in Pleasant, Washington for Mayor John Mitchell and his wife Karen. After the Earth’s crust begins to fall apart, one community must band together and reach higher ground. Between avalanches, volcanos, and mutiny, this caravan has their work cut out for them. It’s a post-apocalyptic road trip they’ll never forget.

programme.title: Falling For a Killer
programme.desc: Over a long weekend, an Assistant District Attorney travels to her estranged family’s country estate to meet her younger sister’s fiancé. He’s seemingly too good to be true: handsome, smart, successful. As the weekend goes on and she learns of his dark past, his behavior becomes increasingly bizarre and she must convince her family of the truth or risk none of them leaving the weekend alive.

programme.title: Boot Hill
programme.desc: Honey Fisher has become a powerful man in this small Western town that has grown up around gold-prospecting fields. Fisher and his gang have managed, through swindling, murder, and terror, to gain leases on the important gold-yielding land in the area. A state commissioner comes to town to review the leases, which are crucial to Fisher's power. Cat Stevens and Hutch Bessy join forces with circus performers and townsfolk led by Stevens' friend Finch to fight against Fisher and his henchmen.

programme.title: Attack Force Z
programme.desc: Mel Gibson commands an elite military team dispatched during WWII to locate and rescue the survivors of a shot-down plane, stranded on a South Pacific island occupied by Japanese. One of the castaways, a defecting Japanese official, holds the secret to ending the war and must be saved at all costs. Boasting a top notch cast including Mel Gibson, Sam Neill, John Phillip Law and John Waters, ATTACK FORCE Z is a fast-moving, action-packed World War II adventure story in the tradition of The Guns of Navarone.

programme.title: Breakout
programme.desc: Imprisonment in a foreign country... it may be a fate far worse than death. Jay Wagner (Robert Duvall) is framed for murder by his scheming grandfather (John Huston). Unjustly convicted, he faces 28 hard years of confinement in a crowded Mexican prision. Wagner's guilt ridden wife Ann (Jill Ireland), who unwittingly aided in framing him by confiding in the grandfather, turn to pilot Nick Colton (Charles Bronson) and his partner Hawk (Randy Quaid) to help Wagner escape. Only the most cunning and daring tactics can spring Wagner, so Colton must plan the impossible. BREAKOUT builds to an explosive climax when Colton launches an all-out desparate helicopter raid that will either rescue the prisoner or cost the lives of all involved.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: In what's been called 'the best Alfred Hitchcock film which he didn't direct,' a man is thrown off a train, and when the police locate his wife, it turns out she knew nothing about him - not even his real name. After her are four men, who insist she's in possession of a huge amount of money which they believe to be theirs. If she doesn't give it to them, she'll be killed.

programme.title: Farmer and the Belle: Saving Santaland, The
programme.desc: When a famous model returns to her small town just before the holidays, she reconnects with her childhood pal who now has a young daughter and a farm. Sparks soon fly between the two and she begins to learn that true love and beauty come from within. But the town is in danger of losing their beloved Santaland festival, though they’ll discover that miracles can happen with determination and faith.

programme.title: A Christmas Tree Miracle
programme.desc: A warm-hearted Christmas tale to remind us that in the holiday season, the best gifts in life are the simple ones, and that miracles do happen, if you believe.

programme.title: Destined at Christmas
programme.desc: Two people meet on Black Friday, get separated, and yearn to reunite—if only they knew each other’s last names and numbers. Can destiny help them find each other by Christmas?

programme.title: Christmas with a Prince: Becoming Royal
programme.desc: Dr. Tasha is off to St. Savarre to spend Christmas with Prince Alex. He proposes, and they immediately begin making plans. Princess Miranda, unhappy about the news, concocts a plan to halt the nuptials.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 5, Episode: 9
programme.desc: Shawn and Gus find themselves in the midst of a Bourne Identity-like hunt and chase after a U.S Government Spy seeks their help in clearing her name for a crime she supposedly didn't commit. Guest starring Franke Potente, Jon Fries, Nestor Carbonell.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 5, Episode: 4
programme.desc: A wealthy widow's young date is murdered, pitting Shawn and Gus against a dirty rotten scoundrel they are convinced trained the victim to be a con artist.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 5, Episode: 5
programme.desc: Shawn and Gus infiltrate a ring of street racing car thieves to catch a killer.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 5, Episode: 6
programme.desc: Two former cops come out of retirement to help Shawn and Gus solve the murder of a former police chief.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 5, Episode: 7
programme.desc: Shawn and Gus help a prison guard locate his escaped inmates while on a ferryboat headed to the Channel Islands. Guest starring Chi McBride.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 5, Episode: 8
programme.desc: While on a murder case involving victims on a liver transplant donor list, Shawn is faced with a man whose criminal profiling skills rival that of his own. Guest starring Nestor Carbonell, Curt Smith ("Tears For Fears").

programme.title: Psych, Season: 5, Episode: 9
programme.desc: Shawn and Gus find themselves in the midst of a Bourne Identity-like hunt and chase after a U.S Government Spy seeks their help in clearing her name for a crime she supposedly didn't commit. Guest starring Franke Potente, Jon Fries, Nestor Carbonell.

programme.title: Psych, Season: 5, Episode: 4

programme.title: The Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Jennifer Aniston and Gerard Butler, two exes continually one-up each other until they find themselves on the run for their lives.

programme.title: The Net
programme.desc: With a story ripped from today's headlines, THE NET is a compelling, high-tech drama about a computer systems analyst (Sandra Bullock) who becomes caught in a web of intrigue and conspiracy when she accidentally taps into a classified program.

Academy Award Winner Kevin Spacey (The Usual Suspects) and young Hollywood super star Kate Boswoth (Superman Returns) star in this clever & adreniline filled heist film. An MIT math whiz is recruited by a teacher to join a specialized team of card counters. They break away from their mentor before casino security finally catches up with them. Based on book "Bringing Down the House." It co-stars Lawrence Fishburne (Matrix Trilogy).

programme.title: My Best Friend's Wedding (1997)
programme.desc: Two friends (Julia Roberts and Dermot Mulroney) go from an impossible possibility to an unimaginable reality in this romantic comedy.

programme.title: Whatever It Takes (2000)
programme.desc: Best friends and neighbors, Ryan Woodman and Maggie Carter, are four weeks away from the prom, and they've agreed to go together if they don't have real dates. Then Chris, a cool guy from the football team, offers to help Ryan connect with Ashley, a popular blond. In exchange, a la Cyrano, Chris needs Ryan's help to get close to Maggie. Ryan makes the deal, helps the dastardly Chris play Maggie, takes advantage of Ashley's lack of self-esteem, loses his values, makes fun of his geeky friends, and falls in Maggie's estimation. Maggie is fooled by Chris, poised to be his next score. Before prom night is over, with its Titanic theme, will Ryan stop sinking?

programme.title: Little Black Book
programme.desc: A young woman's life begins to resemble the daytime TV talk show she works for after she is persuaded to snoop through her boyfriend's Palm Pilot and discovers more than she wants to know about his past - and present.

programme.title: Did You Hear About The Morgans?
programme.desc: The comedy Did You Hear About the Morgans? follows a highly successful Manhattan couple, Meryl and Paul Morgan (Sarah Jessica Parker and Hugh Grant), whose almost-perfect lives have only one notable failure: their dissolving marriage. But the turmoil of their romantic lives is nothing compared to what they are about to experience: they witness a murder and become targets of a contract killer.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Inspector Jarvis sends the officers to seize all “proceeds of crime” – anything purchased with illegal money.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: After the discovery of an executed gang leader, 15 Division must find the killer before a gang war breaks out.

programme.title: Impact Earth
programme.desc: An astronomy professor makes the terrifying discovery that an asteroid is on a collision course with Earth.

programme.title: Superfire
programme.desc: A firefighter pilot blames himself for his colleagues' deaths and must deal with a raging fire in Portland.

programme.title: Frankenstein Meets the Wolf Man
programme.desc: Bela Lugosi as Frankenstein's Monster and Lon Chaney Jr. as the cursed Wolf Man collide in one of the great classic horror films of the 1940s. Beginning as a moody chiller, director Roy William Neill sets the stage for an unforgettable clash. The resurrected Wolf Man, seeking a cure for his malady, enlists the aid of mad scientist Patric Knowles, who claims he will not only rid the Wolf Man of his nocturnal metamorphosis but will also revive the frozen body of Frankenstein's inhuman creation.

programme.title: The Ghost of Frankenstein
programme.desc: The Frankenstein Monster, one of the best-loved feature creatures ever imagined, returns to the screen in The Ghost of Frankenstein, a witty and inventive cinematic gem featuring the talents of Lon Chaney Jr., Sir Cedric Hardwicke and Bela Lugosi. When Ygor (Lugosi) brings the monster (Chaney) to Dr. Ludwig Frankenstein's (Hardwicke) castle, he decides that a brain transplant might be in order. While Dr.

programme.title: Curse of the Werewolf
programme.desc: Oliver Reed portrays the bloodthirsty man-beast who loves by day and kills by night in this gripping gothic thriller. Directed by horror filmmaker Terence Fisher of Hammer Film fame, this atmospheric tale of terror follows Reed, the orphaned baby of a maniacal beggar and a mute girl, from birth to manhood, when he discovers his horrible secret. Try as he may, the cursed youth is unable to suppress the dark forces within.

programme.title: Bud Abbott Lou Costello Meet Frankenstein
programme.desc: Abbott and Costello, as railroad baggage clerks, receive a strange shipment - the last remains of Dracula and Frankenstein's monster. But this deadly duo is still very much alive. So when the shipment arrives at the House of Horrors, the Monsters are not in their crates but have disappeared to a secret hideaway island.

programme.title: Son of Dracula
programme.desc: The greatest movie vampire of all time renews his reign of terror in this atmospheric chiller from the 1940's. Lon Chaney, Jr. known for his portrayals of the Wolf Man and Frankenstein's monster, dons a black cape as Count Alucard (that's Dracula spelled backwards), the bloodthirsty son of the famous Transylvanian vampire. When Katherine (Louise Allbritton), a beautiful Southern girl obsessed with thoughts of eternal life, invites the Count to come to her mansion in the U.S.

programme.title: Lamborghini
programme.desc: Ferruccio Lamborghini is one of the most well-known names in the history of automobiles - he accelerated from his humble beginnings as a mechanic to become the icon that changed the world of motorcars forever. From his intense rivalry with Enzo Ferrari to partying with celebrities, Lamborghini only ever had one rule: to live life at 220 miles per hour. Based on the biography written by his son.

programme.title: Burden
programme.desc: When a museum celebrating the Ku Klux Klan opens in a small town, Reverend Kennedy strives to keep the peace. But his congregation is shocked to discover that his plan includes sheltering Mike Burden, a Klansman.

programme.title: A Mother's Fury
programme.desc: A gripping, tender and thought-provoking thriller written by and starring Siobhan Fallon Hogan (Men in Black) and Robert Patrick (DC’s Peacemaker). When a young college student is killed in a fraternity hazing incident, his mother resorts to extreme measures by taking justice into her own hands when she encounters empty promises in Washington, D.C. Directed by Vibeke Muasya (Twisted).

programme.title: David & Goliath
programme.desc: Expect bloodshed, epic action sequences and sheer fearlessness, in the greatest story ever told! At the crossroads of two great ancient empires, a innocent shepherd named David transforms into a powerful warrior and takes on a terrifyingly violent giant named Goliath. One of history's most legendary Biblical battles is retold in a stylistic, bloody tale of courage and faith.

programme.title: Feather Christmas
programme.desc: For single dad, and veterinarian, Martin, Christmas is all about upholding regular family traditions to keep the memory of his late wife alive. But when an ailing pet chicken arrives at his home-run animal sanctuary, the family's festive plans, and entire world, are turned upside down, as new love blossoms and spreads its wings!

programme.title: Christmas Couple's Retreat
programme.desc: Three couples attend a retreat to strengthen their respective relationships under the guidance of a famed therapist. But as the holiday season unfolds, unexpected challenges arise when the therapist must confront some feelings of her own, and sparks fly when one couple's son unexpectedly falls for the charming retreat manager. Will this festive getaway reignite these couples' love, or will it lead them down an entirely new path?

programme.title: Saving Santa
programme.desc: Once upon a time, Santa operated with just a small workshop and a few elves. But, as Christmas has grown ever bigger, Santa has been forced to innovate! Now his cleverest elves develop amazing technology, including a hologram to hide the North Pole and a time machine to allow Santa to deliver presents to every home in the world, in just the one night. Bernard is an elf who dreams of creating such inventions, but his job is to clean the reindeer stables! Yet when he creates an amazing Christmas memory machine, his luck might be changing. But Bernard's invention is broken by a curious elf, causing the North Pole's power to fail and the hologram hiding it to disappear. Now exposed to the outside world, it is spotted by Santa's enemy, Neville Baddington, who is determined to steal Santa's secrets for himself. The only person who can stop him is Bernard.

programme.title: The Claus Family
programme.desc: After discovering his grandfather is Santa Claus, Jules has to help him deliver his presents all around the world. But Jules' hatred for Christmas might make that more difficult than Santa thought.

programme.title: A Miracle on Christmas Lake
programme.desc: After the loss of his best friend on Christmas Eve, Bobby goes out onto the lake and makes a shocking discovery. When the land is bought, Bobby must rally the town to save it.

programme.title: Bitter Harvest
programme.desc: A Welsh girl moves to 1960s London seeking glamour but finds life harder than expected.

programme.title: The Private Life of Henry VIII
programme.desc: In this oscar winning performace, Charles Laughton plays Henry VIII.

programme.title: This Sporting Life
programme.desc: Richard Harris gives a great performance as a man who wants to quit his job as a miner.

programme.title: Kidnapped
programme.desc: David Balfour is an orphaned young man and the true heir to the title of Master of the Shaws.

programme.title: Hometown Christmas
programme.desc: Noelle Collins revives Louisiana town's live nativity for Christmas.

programme.title: Feliz NaviDAD
programme.desc: David has lost the holiday spirit after losing his wife during Christmas.

programme.title: Hometown Christmas
programme.desc: Noelle Collins revives Louisiana town's live nativity for Christmas.

programme.title: Four Fast Guns
programme.desc: (1960) Western with James Craig. A former gunslinger tries to restore order to a lawless town, but is foiled by the efforts of an evil saloon owner whose infirmity grants him immunity from violence.

programme.title: Air Rescue
programme.desc: Fly with the pilots and intensive care paramedics of The Westpac Lifesaver Rescue Helicopter Service who provide emergency medical treatment and assistance to those in life-threatening situations.

programme.title: Air Rescue
programme.desc: Fly with the pilots and intensive care paramedics of The Westpac Lifesaver Rescue Helicopter Service who provide emergency medical treatment and assistance to those in life-threatening situations.

programme.title: Staged Killer
programme.desc: When a former co-host works his way back into the life of popular TV host Naomi Spencer, the show's success skyrockets, but Naomi's personal life begins to fall apart. Starring Chrishell Stause (2019)

programme.title: An Organized Killer
programme.desc: (2021) Thriller with Allison McAtee. Needing help with her full but chaotic life, Grace hires a live-in assistant. And once Lilith is invited in, there's nothing she won't do... to get what she wants.

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: After wrongly supporting a man who later turned out to be a serial killer, journalist Kate Fisher rebuilds her career but is stalked by someone from her past. Melissa George stars. (2010)

programme.title: An Aurora Teagarden Mystery: A Bundle Of Trouble
programme.desc: (2017) Crime mystery with Candace Cameron Bure and Lexa Doig. A body on her porch. A baby in her bath. A stranger in her closet. Even for super sleuth Aurora, it's a lot to unravel...

programme.title: Good News on GREAT! Extra 2026
programme.desc: Week 33

programme.title: Lost Letter Mysteries: Time To Start Livin'
programme.desc: (2014) Cosy drama with Eric Mabius and Kristin Booth. The Postables receive a letter from a young boy in imminent danger. Can they unravel the mystery and reach him in time?

programme.title: Lost Letter Mysteries: Truth Be Told
programme.desc: (2015) Mystery drama starring Eric Mabius and Kristin Booth. Experts at delivering the undeliverable, the postal detectives take on a brand-new mission: getting a soldier's letter to a bullied teen.

programme.title: Garage Sale Mysteries: Murder Most Medieval
programme.desc: (2017) Flea market felonies with Lori Loughlin. A case hits very close to home for amateur sleuth Jennifer when she finds a body crammed into a vintage suit of armour she purchased.

programme.title: The Christmas Cabin
programme.desc: A city-dweller inherits a holiday cabin only to find that it has already been occupied!

programme.title: Christmas in Vienna
programme.desc: (2020) Festive romance with Sarah Drew and Brennan Elliott. Can disillusioned violinist Jess find the inspiration - and love - she has been missing when she experiences a magical Viennese Christmas?

programme.title: Christmas Sail
programme.desc: (2021) Festive drama with Katee Sackhoff, Terry O'Quinn and Patrick Sabongui. Will it be smooth sailing for Liz as she tries to salvage family ties and rekindle the magic of a Portside Christmas?

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Christmas
programme.desc: (2017) Romance starring Lindy Booth. After a messy public break-up, a woman retreats to her uncle's ranch - where a run-in with a Hollywood actor sparks an unexpected connection.

programme.title: Christmas in Tahoe
programme.desc: (2021) Harmonious romcom with Laura Osnes, Kyle Selig and Pat Monahan. Claire needs a big act to save her festive show. But when her now-famous ex arrives in town, could love also be on the line-up?

programme.title: 12 Days of Giving
programme.desc: When Baxter Billings wins a small fortune at his local mall, he decides to become a Secret Santa in his hometown. His contagious joy of giving at Christmas spreads across town. Baxter forms a close friendship with Pamela and her son.

programme.title: Looks Like Christmas
programme.desc: From cooking to decorating, Carol sleeps and breathes Christmas, so it’s no wonder the town refers to her as “Christmas Carol” but when a handsome man comes to town and challenges her traditional holiday views, Carol must learn how to compromise even if it means facing an unexpected romance.

programme.title: Broadcasting Christmas
programme.desc: When her broadcast partner decides to leave America's most popular morning show, Veronica Daniels announces that she will choose her new co-host from a handful of candidates, including Charlie Fisher, a local New York news anchor.

programme.title: My Christmas Fiancé
programme.desc: A part-time student at a resort restaurant in beautiful Italy is hired by her boss to pose as his fiancée for the holidays, so he can avoid getting married.

programme.title: Spinning Plates
programme.desc: A documentary about three unique restaurants and their respective owners. Examples of it's not what you cook, but why.

programme.title: Blueprint to the Heart
programme.desc: An interior designer trying to save her TV home renovation show needs to apply her successful, upscale home renovation strategy to her blue collar carpenter by making the sweet but disheveled guy her next fixer upper project.

programme.title: Kidnapped to the Island
programme.desc: When a star-struck teenager with a desire to make it as a pop star disappears, her concerned single mom sets out to rescue her from the controlling singer who lured her to a faraway island with promises of fame and fortune.

programme.title: The Captains
programme.desc: The Captains is a feature length documentary film written and directed by William Shatner. The film follows Shatner as he interviews the other actors who have portrayed Starship captains within the illustrious science-fiction franchise.

programme.title: Baby In A Manger
programme.desc: Christmas is about a miracle baby, but when CPS agent Alison and police officer Brock find a lost baby lying in a nativity scene, it'll take a miracle for them just to stop bickering. Can the magic of Christmas help this baby find a home - and maybe even help Alison and Brock see each other in a different light?

programme.title: Love Across Time
programme.desc: While inspecting an old British manor for its real estate potential, Chelsea discovers a portal through time that connects with the late 1700s owner of the property. When an accident occurs, the gentleman comes through and gets stuck in the present day.

programme.title: Christmas Wedding Runaway
programme.desc: A runaway bride does some soul-searching when she's trapped in a snowed-in cabin with her grandmother and an old flame at Christmas.

programme.title: Love in Tahiti
programme.desc: Brielle has always believed the ocean floor is full of treasures just waiting to be found. Over the years she has dived to find coins, lost jewelry and more in the waters of Tahiti. Instead of profiting from them, she loves reuniting people with their lost valuables. When she finds a class ring and returns it to Marcus, a handsome US Navy serviceman, Brielle soon discovers what has been missing in her life – a treasure of the heart.

programme.title: Love Finds You in Sugarcreek
programme.desc: A father and son fleeing a shocking and brutal tragedy settle in the predominantly Amish town of Sugarcreek, Ohio. They are taken in by three sisters who offer the father work as a handyman, but a local policewoman begins to become suspicious of his past.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: At the hospital, Frank comes out of a coma with amnesia. The sheriff wants to know who shot him. Later Frank remembers that something's happening to the president. Who is Frank?

programme.title: Escape From Terror: The Teresa Stamper Story
programme.desc: A young waitress marries a wealthy Oklahoma oilman and is plunged into the deadly world of abuse. When she leaves him, he stalks her, kidnaps her and holds her hostage.

programme.title: Sanctified
programme.desc: A thrilling Western set in 1890 North Dakota, "Sanctified" is the tale of an outlaw rescued from death by a nun traveling the Badlands. A deep friendship develops as she nurses the man back to health in exchange for his guidance to a local church.

programme.title: Guns Of Redemption [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A scarred gunslinger tries leaving violence behind, but his past catches up. Near death from an ambush, he straps on his guns for one final mission.

programme.title: Glengarry Glen Ross [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A group of Chicago real-estate salesmen-cum-con artists live on the edge. Life is good for the one on a roll. For the rest, life hangs in the balance.

programme.title: The Grand Seduction
programme.desc: Brendan Gleeson is Murray, a once proud fisherman who now, along with his former colleagues in the harbour of Tickle Head are out of work and forced to live off welfare.

programme.title: Zookeeper
programme.desc: In this warm-hearted comedy, the animals at one particular zoo love their caretaker, Griffin Keyes (Kevin James). But when Griffin decides the only way he can get a girl in his life is to find a more glamorous job, the animals, in a panic, break their time-honored code of silence...

programme.title: The Pink Panther
programme.desc: When a star soccer coach is murdered and his priceless Pink Panther diamond stolen, France is in an uproar. Fortunately, Inspector Jacques Clouseau (Steve Martin) is on the case with his trusted partner Gilbert Ponton (Jean Reno). Will he seduce the pop diva, Xania (Beyoncé Knowles)?

programme.title: Vicky Cristina Barcelona
programme.desc: Vicky Cristina Barcelona has become one of the most talked about movies of the year. A sizzling, erotically charged, relentlessly hilarious and touching romantic comedy.

programme.title: Saints & Soliders 2: Airborne Creed
programme.desc: On August 15th 1944, the 517th Parachute Regimental Combat Team (PRCT) jumped over the south of France. In their effort to complete the mission and rendezvous with their unit, three isolated paratroopers come across a group of French resistants in desperate need.

programme.title: Warriors' Gate
programme.desc: American teenager Jack Bronson is magically transported to ancient China, where he must become a hero and rescue a beautiful princess from the clutches of the evil barbarian king.

programme.title: Samaritan
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, Granite City’s hometown hero, Samaritan, was reported dead after a fiery warehouse battle with his rival, Nemesis. Most in the city believe he perished in the fire, but one young boy holds out hope that Samaritan still lives!

programme.title: Deadly Inferno
programme.desc: During some extensive renovations on an eight-storey office building, a major gas leak leads to a terrible explosion, trapping the injured staff in a fiery maze. Can the brave firefighters provide a safe exit from this deadly inferno?

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: The Middle Ages may never be the same after street smart Jamal Walker falls into a moat at the Medieval World theme park and finds himself transported back in time.

programme.title: Before You Know It
programme.desc: An unmissable New-York- based “dramedy” in the vein of Woody Allen. Stage manager Rachel (Hannah Pearl Utt) is the only thing standing between her family and utter chaos. She then discovers that her presumed-dead mother (Judith Light: Transparent) is alive and thriving as a soap-opera star!

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Two Brazilian billionaires hire a pair of look-alikes to temporarily take their place and find out who is trying to assassinate them.

programme.title: Dear Elizabeth
programme.desc: A man who leads a dull life accidentally stalks an old college classmate, actress Elizabeth Banks, on social media. He rediscovers more of himself and the true meaning of friendship in his attempts to prove he knows her.

programme.title: The Hole

programme.title: When good intentions backfire SPECTACULARLY
programme.desc: After their recent break away from the kids to ‘disconnect and reconnect’ Abbey and Pete are back with tales of when even the best of intentions can backfire with hilarious results. Thailand in the depths of monsoon season? programme.title: Wedding Planning
programme.desc: On today’s episode, we get an exclusive invite to the planning behind the wedding of the decade. From pre-match nerves to Elton John’s florist - learn more about the planning of the most important day of Abbey’s life (and probably Pete’s as well). We also hear how Abbey feels how she has made a load of new friends since starting the podcast and why Peter is still struggling to show his face in the bakery after THAT famous incident. And your favourite Agony Ab is back, helping to navigate the tricky waters of what to do when your girlfriend plans, and pays for, your wedding without your knowledge but on your credit card and how to get out of your sister’s OTT wedding prep.

programme.title: To Dream The Impossible Dream
programme.desc: In this week’s Therapy Crouch, Abbey and Peter take a while to sit down and discuss some of their dreams and aspirations both as a pair of youngsters and now as one of the UK’s most prominent power couples. We hear about Abbey’s early days in Genie Queen - Liverpool’s answer to the Sugababes - and a young football protege with dreams of scoring 100 premier league goals and becoming the nation’s Podfather in the process. We also hear from our lovely listeners with their Weekly Whines and Agony Abs. We hear about one of listeners whose girlfriend has being using their toothbrush for bit of DIY and a fellow NETTO alumni has been in touch with a playground anthem that has been sung for generations across Merseyside. Enjoy this week’s Therapy Crouch!

programme.title: They Call Me The Godfather
programme.desc: Welcome back to The Therapy Crouch! On this week’s episode Abbey and Peter are on hand to share some pearls of wisdom on what makes a good godparent, and some top tips on how to expertly navigate a thanks but no thanks conversation with your nearest and dearest. In Agony Ab, Abbey and Peter are on hand to help when your better half suddenly decides to take up the gym 10 years too late and we hear from Louis, one of our international listeners who needs some advice on how to make the first move! We hope you enjoy this very special episode from the OG Podfather and your fairy Podmother!

programme.title: The Therapy Crouch’s Christmas Party!!!
programme.desc: It is a double celebration in the Crouch household after Scott pulled his finger out and asked the big Q - which has prompted some discussions on Abbey trading hers in for an upgrade (ring not fella) Although it isn’t all festive cheer as the pair have been up to their usual antics and have come locked and loaded with multiple weekly whines - a lot of of them regarding the other’s fashion faux pas. And fear not, we are not abandoning you guys with your own relationship woes, Agony Ab is still on the couch to help with your long distance heart ache and those of you who are struggling with husbands who have little to no interest in putting the Christmas tree up!! Bah humbug! Enjoy this week’s Therapy Crouch

programme.title: The Therapy Crouch - Will You Marry Me?
programme.desc: This week, Abbey and Peter provide a schooling session on how to nail the perfect proposal (spoiler: It does not involve chemtrails) Weekly Whine club is also back, with Abbey and Peter going a bit more upmarket to celebrate the roaring success that is The Therapy Crouch! We learn why you can't trust Abbey to keep a clean car and how Peter is considering taking up a career modelling fake tan. And, as always, Agony Ab is on hand to give you the listener some advice for your tricky relationship problems. Enjoy!

programme.title: Carol Vorderman Talks Politics, Education, and Parenting
programme.desc: Broadcaster Carol Vorderman discusses her early life, from her family running away with the circus and living out of a car, to being one of the first girls to read engineering at Cambridge University. She reveals who wrote her first application to Countdown and explains why everything about our lives is political, from the pressure put on kids and parents by schools to women's bodily autonomy.

programme.title: Poorna Bell On How To Put Yourself First
programme.desc: Award-winning journalist and author Poorna Bell joins Fearne to talk about ageing, ambition, marriage, motherhood, grief and the quiet rage that can build when women feel invisible. From challenging the narrative that women "disappear" in midlife, to questioning the myth of "having it all", this conversation is about reclaiming agency, on your own terms.

programme.title: Liz Earle On Her Perimenopause And Midlife Reinvention
programme.desc: Broadcaster and healthy ageing expert Liz Earle discusses her transformation from overwhelmed, overweight, and exhausted during perimenopause to thriving in her 60s. She shares the lifestyle shifts that improved her health, including the importance of morning light and circadian rhythms, strength training, sleep, and consistency in wellbeing.

programme.title: Ruby Wax On Why Trump Scares Her!
programme.desc: Have you noticed that your memory and rational thinking disappear when you're anxious? Ruby Wax wants you to retrain your focus and attention in a digital world that's always trying to steal it. In this chat with Fearne – live from the Happy Place Festival – Ruby explains the difference between mental health and mental illness, and why she calls meditation 'mind gym'.

programme.title: Dr Julie on Triggers And Behaviour Patterns
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Julie Smith discusses why criticism hurts so deeply, explaining how your brain needs evidence rather than mantras to build self-worth and change your critical inner voice. She explores why feedback from others can trigger old wounds and how patterns developed in childhood keep replaying in adulthood.

programme.title: Ruth Langsford On Coping With Grief & Loss
programme.desc: Broadcaster Ruth Langsford opens up about navigating divorce, grief, and the emotional reality of caring for parents with dementia. From therapy breakthroughs to the power of female friendships, Ruth shares the tools that have helped her find strength in life's most difficult moments. Fearne and Ruth compare their experiences of mum guilt, and why it's so important for young boys in particular to see the women in their life working. Ruth also reveals the sliding doors moment that led her to her TV presenting career. Content warning: this episode contains conversations about grief after suicide.

programme.title: Zayn Malik's Secret to Slow Living
programme.desc: Musician Zayn talks through the quiet lifestyle he loves in Pennsylvania: painting, being outdoors, spending time with his daughter, and staying off his phone. He explains how fatherhood has changed him, whether he's the parent he thought he would be, and what impact the new depths of emotion he feels has had on his music.

programme.title: Catherine Connolly On Palestine And A United Ireland
programme.desc: We speak with Irish presidential candidate Catherine Connolly. We look at the shape of Ireland, the involvement of younger people in politics, the Occupied Territories Bill, Irish neutrality and the triple lock. Catherine also speaks about the importance of the Irish language and why it's important to have women in politics and in the public eye.

programme.title: Brian Kerr On Beating Portugal And Ireland's Underage Triumphs
programme.desc: Brian Kerr reflects on his biggest successes with St Patrick's Athletic in the League of Ireland, his time in charge of Ireland's underage teams and beating Portugal and Netherlands as Ireland senior football manager.

programme.title: Brian Cox’s Guide To Being A True Scot
programme.desc: Brian Cox sets the record straight on what it really means to be Scottish. From authentic Scottish slang to the biggest misconceptions people, especially in America, still get wrong. With sharp wit and no-nonsense honesty, he dives into real Scottish slang and what it actually means, the stereotypes that need binning immediately, the cultural differences that confuse the rest of the world, and a cheeky look at some of America's more baffling takes on Scotland.

programme.title: Big Tech Is Destroying Democracy - Beeban Kidron Interview
programme.desc: Baroness Beeban Kidron, filmmaker and tech campaigner, discusses her book Users: How Big Tech Took Control and How to Fight Back. She breaks down how big tech companies have influenced democracy, warped regulatory structures for their own benefit, and knowingly harmed their users.

programme.title: When Did Elon Musk Lose His Mind?
programme.desc: When did Elon Musk make the jump from salesman to supervillain? Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff trace Musk's journey from tech billionaire to stalwart of the online right. From his upbringing in apartheid South Africa to the rise of Tesla and SpaceX, they detail his changing views on AI and the "woke mind virus", as well as his eventual alliance with Donald Trump. Slobodian and Tarnoff examine his industrial philosophy, what led him to the White House, his purchase of Twitter, and his various attempts to further fuse technology into our lives.

programme.title: We Quiz FLO On Their Own Songs
programme.desc: FLO go head-to-head in the ultimate JOE Pub Quiz. The girls put their music knowledge to the test in a rapid-fire battle featuring rounds including Guess the Legendary Song from the First 5 Seconds, Do They Know Their Own Song Lyrics and a test of their general music knowledge. Along the way, FLO take on Zara Larsson's iconic Lush Life dance, chat Ariana Grande, Rihanna and more, and things get seriously competitive as they battle it out to become the one and only JOE Pub Quiz champion.

programme.title: Tom Holland vs Zendaya vs Jacob - Spider Man Quiz Showdown
programme.desc: Tom Holland, Zendaya and Jacob Batalon go head-to-head in the ultimate Spider-Man pub quiz. These legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their Spider-Man films. Do they know their lines, know about the franchise and even know random stills from the films? With bragging rights on the line and the title of pub quiz champion up for grabs, things quickly descend into chaos, confusion and comedy.

programme.title: Old People Try Bizarre Food
programme.desc: The Old People are back, this time taking on some of the internet's most bizarre celebrity food combinations. From viral TikTok trends to A-list guilty pleasures, they try and rate Dua Lipa's Pickle Diet Coke, Channing Tatum's Peanut Butter, Jelly & Cheetos Sandwich, and Beyoncé's Banana with Ketchup. Will these celebrity creations be surprisingly delicious or completely disgusting. Our Old People give their brutally honest verdicts.

programme.title: Keir Starmer’s Weirdest Moments As Prime Minister
programme.desc: Keir Starmer's time in office has come to a close. His legacy includes some strange moments. From meeps to releasing sausages to going footy mad, relive all of the best and worst moments from the last two years. Hear clashes with Rishi Sunak and Kemi Badenoch, awkward encounters with Donald Trump, and gaffes at various major summits.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Donald Trump’s Most Embarrassing Moments
programme.desc: Donald Trump has a lot to say about the world. That doesn't mean he knows what he's talking about. From China to Venezuela and Canada to the UK, watch Trump's questionable comments about all corners of the globe.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Generational - Football Debate
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Wild Slovakia

programme.title: mareTV: Peru - Coast of the Incas
programme.desc: Dramatically, the coast plunges into the sea, the so-called Costa of Peru is a gigantic desert on the Pacific Ocean, 2,400 kilometers long. Rugged, bizarre, like from another star. Ancient cultures settled here, the Moche and the Chimú. Later the proud Inca, the self-proclaimed royal people of the Andes, ruled. In the small town of Huanchaco in northern Peru, the fishermen build a new boat every month: from reed. The small ships are called Caballito de Totora (reed horses), because the shape is reminiscent of a horse and the fishermen ride in it kneeling in the waves. About 2,000 years ago, the moche used it to go out to sea. Carlos Segura Azola is a descendant of the moche. He is currently building a "reed horse" again. But actually something completely different occupies him. Carlos has been afraid of the sea ever since his father drowned at work. The fisherman consults a Brucha, a witch. She tries to drive him out of panic at the Pacific with mysterious ceremonies. At some point Carlos' reed boat is finished and he has to get out to his nets again. In the south, in the port city of Pisco, there are hardly any private cars. Mototaxis on three wheels are the means of transport here. Every moto looks different, because the young drivers compete with each other. They constantly pimp out their tricycles with spoilers, mirrors and all kinds of decorations. Because if you stand out in the traffic jam, you get the most passengers. But nowhere else in Peru is road traffic as dense and chaotic as in the capital Lima. That's why Juan Ortiz goes daily with his Delta glider over the coastal road into the air. He is the flying reporter and reports live for the traffic news. And he is not alone with his aircraft. Dozens of paragliders float along the cliffs of Lima at any time of the day. The Pacific provides a constant upwind on the up to 160 meter high cliffs. Somewhere in the labyrinth of the metropolis of millions hundreds of believers trot to the beat of the music of a Jesus statue on the cross. A procession for the "Lord of Miracles", the brass band intones church songs. The music student Bruno Alvarado drags and plays the largest instrument, a sousaphone. Every day there are dozens of processions in Lima. Practical for Bruno, he finances his studies with the musical accompaniment. Away from the hustle and bustle of the big city, in the Paracas National Park, it is deserted. Luis Zapato runs a kiosk on a lonely beach amidst huge sand dunes. The kiosk has meanwhile developed into a gourmet temple, even the capital city dwellers flock here. Especially because of the scallops that Luis is the only licence holder to collect far and wide from the seabed. Inti Mar he called his beach snack, Inti is the sun god, Mar the sea. At Luis you literally eat like a sun god at the sea. This is only possible here, on the Inca coast.

programme.title: mareTV: Mexico's Caribbean Coast
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a "solution for our planet's refuse problem". Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to catch lobsters by adhering to the traditional method and were awarded an "Eco seal for sustainable fishing" for their trouble. It is silent under water off Isla Mujeres and it is here that the artist Jason deCaires has constructed a sculpture park. Hundreds of lifesize figures form an artificial reef at a depth of 12 metres. Fish and plants complete his work of art. The master himself is convinced: "Mother Nature is the true artist".

programme.title: glCuba - Brilliantly Caribbean
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly beautiful workplace. The lifeguards' territory ex-tends for more than 20 kilometres. In order to protect the coasts of Cuba, mangroves have been replanted here for many years. The project is supported by the UN and planting is often carried out by schoolchildren. In doing so, Cuban children learn how to treat their maritime habitat in a sustainable fashion. The former colonial city of Trinidad on Cuba's south coast is gen-erally considered to be one of the most beautiful places in the entire Caribbean. The houses here are particular-ly colourful. A plethora of magnificent buildings can be seen at the Plaza Mayor, the neo-baroque main square.

programme.title: Wild Spain: The Mediterranean South
programme.desc: From the dreamlike Mediterranean and spectacular canyon landscapes of Andalusia, to the expanses of the Extremadura with its holm oak forests that stretch toward the horizon. Even in the south of Spain, highly popular with holidaymakers, there is still much waiting to be discovered. Genets hunt for prey under cover of night. These viverrid representatives can be found in their greatest numbers on the Iberian Peninsula. And nowhere else in Europe are there as many vultures as here in Spain. It’s an unparalleled spectacle, when griffon vultures quarrel over carrion. The European Chameleon has a by far more ingenious method of feeding: within a fraction of a second, he shoots out his half-a-metre-long tongue; once in his sights, the insects don’t have a chance. The unmistakeable hoopoe with his typical feather bonnet is also pleased with the rich variety of insects on offer in Spain. Especially in the spring, when the birds have to feed their insatiable juniors. With around 30,000 brooding couples, white storks have one of their most important areas of distribution in Spain. But it’s underwater, where the wealth of animals in Southern Spain reaches its zenith. The protected reserves in the Mediterranean reveal an incomparable variety of species: weird sea slugs of almost alien appearance, graceful sea horses, huge swarms of barracudas and elegant blue sharks all have their habitat here. Spain’s south has shaped the identity of the regions inhabitants. The film accompanies a farmer in the Extremadura, Spain’s Wild West, as well as a fisherman who operates sustainable fishing off the coast of the Cabo de Gata reserve. Common to both is the fact that neither of them would consider exchanging their homeland for a life in the city. Wild Spain – The Mediterranean South reveals the unknown side of a region that many think they know, but in which there is so much more to discover.

programme.title: Wild Germany: Mountains
programme.desc: A mother lynx feeds on freshly caught prey with her cubs, agile chamoix leap along mountain ledges, bee-eaters dig nesting holes in vineyards, black storks bring up their young on narrow ridges. From the rugged peaks of the Alps and the dark woods of the Black Forest to the sandstone cliffs of Saxonian Switzerland, Germany’s mountains are home to very special animals. The episode Mountains from the four-part series Wild Germany shows a world full of breath-taking images. We witness the first few days of baby marmots in Alpine meadows, inexperienced and unaware of the dangers lurking outside the den. The opportunity that the golden eagle in the cliff face has been waiting for. Taking to the air, it glides over the steeply sloping pasture. The older marmots recognize the danger and send out shrill alarm whistles. Will the younger marmots heed the warnings in time? It’s been more than 150 years since the last lynx was seen in Germany. After a reintroduction project in the Czech Republic, the first big cats crossed the border into the Bavarian forest. Similar projects in the Harz mountains have also brought the lynx back to Northern Germany. Only 30km South of Dresden, majestic table mountains stretch into the sky: Saxonian Switzerland with its unspoilt rocky cliffs and towers. Habitat of peregrine falcons and white-throated dippers, as well as the shy and seldom seen dormouse. The spectacular beauty and diversity of form of the Elbe Sandstone Mountains are unique in Europe. The film shows the magnificence of the mountains in the different seasons and the rich variety of flora and fauna. Unique animal footage rounds off the portrait of landscapes which have much more than just barren rocks to offer.

programme.title: Wildest Europe

programme.title: Wildest Middle East

programme.title: Wild Assassins: Tusk and Horns

programme.title: Wild Iran: To the South
programme.desc: At the first part of his journey, the photographer is lucky to get some shots of rare animal species. Between the gaps of the rocky mountains he traces funny creatures: Pica. They look like a mixture between hamsters and rabbits. From his hideout Benny Rebel manages to observe impressive Ibexes, a kind of wild goats with huge horns. Equipped with a special microcopter and night shot camera traps he tries to get a sneak into the life of shy inhabitants of the steppe. In his adventure he encounters lonesome dromedary herds and discovers a spooky cave of hyenas. Rebel witnesses owls, snakes and lizards living between the antique ruins of the old Persian capital Persepolis. Benny Rebel also is interested in the relationship between men and nature. He meets not only ranger in the wild, but also visitors of the magnificent Persian gardens in the middle of rough deserts. Between the fountains of freshly sputtering water pelicans take a bath. Young and old people walk in the green paradises in front of attractive mosques. Unexpected the 43 year old photographer meets animal lovers on the roof tops of urban houses. The bet on the flying skills of their specific breed of pigeons. And like a house from a fairy tale seem the historical pigeon towers with their unique architecture housing more than ten thousands of birds. Finally Benny Rebel traces an Asiatic cheetah in the semi desert. Less than a hundred of the big cats are left in the wild. The nature conservationist and photographer decides to come closer to the dangerous carnivore.
